judgments.label: true_positive
judgments.rationale: The element is a 55x55 icon (a phone on an orange circle) inside the 'Respondendo' card link in 'Nossos sites'. The link's visible text already gives its purpose ('Respondendo Espaço para o informante do IBGE...'), so the icon is decorative. Its alt is 'imagem banner', a placeholder that says nothing about the image and that a screen reader still announces (the container's reading text starts 'imagem banner Respondendo...'). The same alt is used on every banner on the page. This is documented failure F39 (a non-null alt like 'image' on an image AT should ignore), and F30 (placeholder text used as the alternative). The finding's claim that the alt is too generic to work as a text alternative holds. The patch ('Ícone de celular') is weaker than alt="", but that does not change the label. The live page on 2026-10-09 still has alt="imagem banner".
